mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when UNRATE is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%) signals a deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when INDPRO is below 100 and UNRATE is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 1.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift to higher rates compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 700,000 units) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when HOUST is above 700,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST above 700,000 units) and retail sales (RSAFS above 400,000 million dollars) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when HOUST is above 700,000 and RSAFS is above 400,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE above 5.0%), the labor market weakness directly reduces household income and consumption, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when UNRATE is above 5.0%.
